## AuthController — Service Interface Dependencies & Implementations

**Controller:**

| File |
|------|
| `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/controller/AuthController.java` |

---

### 1. `UserService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `common/dao-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/user/UserService.java`
- **Implementation:** `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/user/UserServiceImpl.java`
- Methods used: `replaceUserCredentials`, `findUserById`, `findUserCredentialsByResetToken`, `setUserCredentialsEnabled`, `activateUserCredentials`, `findUserCredentialsByUserId`, `requestPasswordReset`, `findUserCredentialsByActivateToken`

### 2. `SystemSecurityService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/system/SystemSecurityService.java`
- **Implementation:** `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/system/DefaultSystemSecurityService.java`
- Methods used: `getBaseUrl`, `validatePassword`, `logLoginAction`

### 3. `MailService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `rule-engine/rule-engine-api/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/rule/engine/api/MailService.java`
- **Implementation:** `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/mail/DefaultMailService.java`
- Methods used: `sendPasswordWasResetEmail`, `sendAccountActivatedEmail`, `sendResetPasswordEmailAsync`

### 4. `TwoFactorAuthService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/auth/mfa/TwoFactorAuthService.java`
- **Implementation:** `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/auth/mfa/DefaultTwoFactorAuthService.java`
- Methods used: `isEnforceTwoFaEnabled`

### 5. `SecuritySettingsService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/settings/SecuritySettingsService.java`
- **Implementation:** `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/settings/DefaultSecuritySettingsService.java`
- Methods used: `getSecuritySettings`

### 6. `RateLimitService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `common/cache/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/cache/limits/RateLimitService.java`
- **Implementation:** `common/cache/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/cache/limits/DefaultRateLimitService.java`
- Methods used: `checkRateLimit`

> Note: `JwtTokenFactory` is a `@Component` class (not an interface) so it has no separate interface/implementation split.
